afterImage.name: Harbor Logistics, LLC
afterImage.subsector: Port-centric warehousing, transload and drayage infrastructure
afterImage.description: Harbor Logistics, LLC is a port-centric transportation and logistics infrastructure platform based in North Charleston, South Carolina. The company operates asset-based warehousing, rail transload, intermodal drayage and trucking, fulfillment, packaging, brokerage and export-consolidation services across the southeastern United States. NOVA Infrastructure established Harbor through its December 2021 acquisition of Premier Logistics Solutions and subsequently added ATS Logistics and A&R Bulk-Pak, which combined into the surviving Harbor brand in July 2025. NOVA remains the only disclosed current platform owner; its exact economic percentage and intermediate acquisition vehicle are not publicly disclosed.
afterImage.headquarters: North Charleston, South Carolina, United States

ownershipPeriods.stake: Controlling owner; exact percentage not publicly disclosed

milestones.event: NOVA Infrastructure completed the Premier Logistics Solutions acquisition and established the Harbor Logistics platform.
Harbor acquired ATS Logistics, adding port drayage, warehousing and customs infrastructure in Charleston.
Harbor Logistics and A&R Bulk-Pak combined under the Harbor brand, creating a platform with more than 300 employees and over one million square feet of warehouse space.
